Subject: [Bug 5836]  New: SpamAssassin doesn't decode URL-encoding in mailto: scheme urls

https://issues.apache.org/SpamAssassin/show_bug.cgi?id=5836

           Summary: SpamAssassin doesn't decode URL-encoding in mailto:
                    scheme urls
           Product: Spamassassin
           Version: 3.2.4
          Platform: Other
        OS/Version: other
            Status: NEW
          Severity: normal
          Priority: P5
         Component: spamassassin
        AssignedTo: xrh@spamassassin.apache.org
        ReportedBy: purka@proofpoint.com
                CC: vutrpes@proofpoint.com


Spammers start to do URL-encoding in mailto scheme, something like this:

cawyyfzeylk@apache%2Eorg

And the url list returned by SpamAssasin would look like:

mailto:cawyyfzeylk@apache%2Eorg

Looks like that API uri_list_canonify() in Util.pm ignores mailto when doing
canonify process.

Will attach test case.
